name: floret
description: YouTube transcript + script analysis (hooks, format, storytelling) via Floret.
long_description: Floret fetches YouTube captions, reflows them into a readable script, and analyzes format, angle, storytelling, hooks, and visuals. This Desktop extension runs locally and calls your hosted Floret API — same tools as the remote MCP connector (get_transcript, analyze_video).

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Fetch a YouTube video transcript as a reflowed readable script

tools.name: analyze_video
tools.description: Analyze a YouTube video script for format, angle, storytelling, hooks, and visuals

api_key.title: API key (optional)
api_key.description: Bearer token if your Floret deploy requires Authorization (MCP_API_KEY). Leave empty for public REST.
